title: Morse — Telegraph in Telegram
description: Ask the Telegraph miner network from any MCP client with no wallet: Morse pays the x402 fee, Telegraph's router picks the ranked miner, every answer returns a receipt with the miner, rank, cost, settlement tx and signal hash.
